CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountBalance_TRY] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance
AS(
SELECT
BTT.CounterParty_ID AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE
    WHEN BTT.product_type LIKE 'Bond%' AND BTT.book = 'Client' AND BTT.bundle_type <> 'ASSET SWAP' AND BTT.tradestatus = 'VERIFIED' 
    AND BTT.maturity_date > CONVERT(DATE,left(right(file_name,12),8)) THEN 'Fixed Income Product Outstanding' 
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.BOOK in ('F_Intl_MM_Team1',  'F_Intl_MM_Team2',  'R_Dom_MM_Team1', 'R_Dom_MM_Team2', 'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing') 
    AND btt.bundle_type <> 'PYA' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'Money Market Product Outstanding'
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA' 
    AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding' 
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding'
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%' AND BTT.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' AND BTT.MATURITY_DATE > CONVERT(DATE,left(right(file_name,12),8)) THEN 'Structured Product Asset Swap'
    END AS BalanceTypeId
,CONVERT(DATE,left(right(file_name,12),8)) AS [TIMESTAMP]
,CASE
    WHEN BTT.product_type LIKE 'Bond%' AND BTT.book = 'Client' AND BTT.bundle_type <> 'ASSET SWAP' AND BTT.tradestatus = 'VERIFIED' 
    AND BTT.maturity_date > CONVERT(DATE,left(right(file_name,12),8)) THEN BTT.NOMINAL 
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.BOOK in ('F_Intl_MM_Team1',  'F_Intl_MM_Team2',  'R_Dom_MM_Team1', 'R_Dom_MM_Team2', 'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing') 
    AND btt.bundle_type <> 'PYA' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN BTT.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA' 
    AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN BTT.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT 
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN BTT.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%' AND BTT.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' AND BTT.MATURITY_DATE > CONVERT(DATE,left(right(file_name,12),8)) THEN BTT.NOMINAL END AS BalanceAmount 
,BTT.TRADE_CURRENCY AS IsoCurrencyCode
,'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode
,BTT.Insert_Dttm AS INSERTDTTM
,BTT.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
from BUSC.TRY_TRADES_bu_20230713 BTT
WHERE BTT.CounterParty_ID IS NOT NULL and BTT.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance
WHERE BalanceTypeId IS NOT NULL;
--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,[CustomerAccountId])
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,[BalanceTypeId])
,CONVERT(numeric,[BalanceAmount])
,CONVERT(char,[IsoCurrencyCode])
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,BalanceTypeId, [Timestamp], FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance
)


,

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.[CustomerAccountId])
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.[BalanceTypeId])
,CONVERT(numeric,A.[BalanceAmount])
,CONVERT(char,A.[IsoCurrencyCode])
)) HASHROW, A.CustomerAccountId,A.BalanceTypeId, A.[Timestamp], A.FinancialInstitutionId, A.SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance A
JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
		ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.BalanceTypeId, TGT.BalanceTypeId) AS BalanceTypeId
,ISNULL(SRC.[Timestamp], TGT.[Timestamp]) AS [Timestamp]
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode, TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'INSERT'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
	AND SRC.BalanceTypeId = TGT.BalanceTypeId
        	AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
            	AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA;



;
--select * from  BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance where SourceSystemCode = 'try'
--INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[BalanceTypeId]
,[Timestamp]
,[BalanceAmount]
,[IsoCurrencyCode]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
)
SELECT
DISTINCT
SRC.[CustomerAccountId]
,SRC.[BalanceTypeId]
,SRC.[Timestamp]
,SUM(SRC.[BalanceAmount]) AS BalanceAmount
,SRC.[IsoCurrencyCode]
,'TRY' AS [SourceSystemCode]
,0 AS [WorkFlowId]
,0 AS [TaskRunId]
,SRC.[InsertDttm]
,SRC.[FinancialInstitutionId]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA DELTA	 
ON  DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.BalanceTypeId = SRC.BalanceTypeId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT')
AND BalanceAmount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY SRC.[CustomerAccountId]
,SRC.[BalanceTypeId]
,SRC.[Timestamp]
,SRC.[InsertDttm]
,SRC.[FinancialInstitutionId]
,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance_DELTA;


END
GO
